definition.aodTerm: excluded because the six-seed 200k 0.30-to-0.40 derivative is not numerically resolved; exclusion makes this a partial/lower-bound random budget, not a full covariance model
definition.commonSystematic: kept separate because it is correlated across rows; per-row sqrt(partialRandom^2 + commonSystematic^2) is orientation only, not an independent-error covariance replacement

conclusion: After replacing the unstable single-seed central estimator and reconverging the timing derivative, the Taylor late-primary residuals are not compelling standalone inconsistencies. Rows24-25 are about 1.48 partial-random sigma before the correlated common systematic and before any AOD contribution; a per-row orientation including the common systematic is about 1.07-1.08 sigma. This is not a renewed global chi-square or validation classification because the AOD derivative is unresolved and rows1-22 do not yet have a compatible empirical broadband numerical-uncertainty treatment.
boundary: Analysis-only partial/lower-bound uncertainty budget. AOD is deliberately not set to zero: it is marked unresolved and excluded. The common systematic remains correlated and is not converted into independent row noise. No ABSOLUTE_CONSISTENT/SHAPE_CONSISTENT classification, atmosphere fit, AOD fit, Level-B/F/tau/production, or human-model conclusion is authorized.
